verdict.rationale: Mollie publishes an llms.txt index, which a probe confirmed returns HTTP 200 at docs.mollie.com/llms.txt. Its docs also tell agents to append .md to any page URL for a markdown version, and the cited doc URLs use that .md convention. Missing for 10: hands-on verification that the .md mirrors serve clean markdown, and evidence of a consolidated llms-full.txt or other agent-specific guidance beyond the index.
